result_json.message: docs: add review budget inspection implementation plan

items.title: Phase 6/W6 depends on unimplemented plan 210 but is in this plan's scored sequential scope
items.reason: Design 209 never requires implementation-domain inspection; 210 is approved but unimplemented. Phase 6 instructs blocking/leaving unchecked when 210 is absent, yet W6 is in B=22 and estimated against nonexistent interfaces. Choosing between splitting it to a follow-up plan versus an explicit deferral mechanism is a scope decision.
items.failure: A phase-sequential implementation run reaches Phase 6 after Phase 5 and stalls (cannot complete the plan) or requires an ad-hoc mid-run human gate; W6 points/architecture burden in the baseline are unverifiable.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Move Phase 6/W6 to a follow-up plan triggered by 210 integration, keeping Phase 5's BUDGET_INSPECTION_UNSUPPORTED guard as the forward-compatibility contract; or add an explicit orchestrator-visible deferral condition and its budget treatment.

items.title: No canonical per-snapshot budget reconstruction; routeAfterDecision requires nullable snapshot.derived
items.reason: routeAfterDecision throws when latestBudgetSnapshot.derived is null (routing.ts:381-383) and deriveEnforced reads B0/I/thresholds from that base budget. derived is projection-only (null after rebuild/archived memory reads). deriveBudget input assembly already exists in review-budget/apply.ts:337-351 and run-v1.handler.ts:1205-1236; the plan does not name a shared helper, so inspection would add a third copy and may omit semanticHumanRequired from the paired verdict or the as-of governing B.
items.failure: Inspection of archived or index-wiped runs throws or reconstructs requiresHuman/alerts that differ from the recorded decoration, breaking the plan's wiped-index parity acceptance and the no-copied-formulas requirement.
items.lowestCostCorrection: In Phase 2, name one shared pure helper building recorded-review budget inputs (baseline, snapshot prefix, paired verdict semanticHumanRequired, as-of governing B, first baselineAssessment I, configSnapshot); make the effective-state helper take an explicit base budget; keep routeAfterDecision as a behavior-preserving wrapper; add a null-derived parity test; update Files Touched/Surface Snapshot.

items.title: Linear single-pass fold gate conflicts with existing per-decision rescanning acceptance/fold helpers
items.reason: classifyDecisionAcceptance decodes the full budget stream and scans all steps per decision, and foldGoverningReviewState calls it per decision. Folding each history prefix with these helpers is O(events x decisions x (steps+budget)), contradicting Phase 2's read/fold-once requirement and operation-count regression unless acceptance logic is privately copied.
items.failure: Implementer either fails the long-history operation-count completion gate or reimplements decision acceptance privately, creating a second policy engine.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Specify extracting classify/fold variants that accept a pre-decoded snapshot index and precomputed step positions (acceptance is prefix-invariant once the human step is included), keep existing exports as parity-tested wrappers, fold incrementally in one ordered pass, and add decisions.ts to Files Touched.

result_json.summary: Well-grounded plan with a strong read-only and actionability model, but Phase 6 depends on unimplemented plan 210 inside this plan's scored sequential scope (human scope decision), and two mechanical gaps: no canonical per-snapshot budget reconstruction (routeAfterDecision requires nullable derived) and a linear-fold gate that conflicts with the rescanning acceptance helpers.

baselineAssessment.reason: W1-W5 plausible at ~19 with W1 slightly light (exact-run archived extraction/discovery); P1.2/P1.3 shared-helper extractions add ~1 each; W6 is estimated against unimplemented 210 interfaces and is likely light.
